gemini.title: Conservation Areas
gemini.abstract: Boundaries of conservation areas designated by local planning authorities in England for their special architectural or historic interest. The dataset is compiled and published by Historic England.
gemini.lineage: Published by Historic England as part of the National Heritage List for England (NHLE). Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: uid
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to the conservation-area record by the source dataset.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.

columns.name: date_of_de
columns.description: Date on which the local planning authority designated the conservation area.

columns.name: date_updat
columns.description: Date on which the conservation-area record or boundary was last updated.

columns.name: lpa
columns.description: Local planning authority responsible for designating and managing the conservation area.

columns.name: capture_sc
columns.description: Map scale used to capture the conservation-area boundary.

columns.name: x
columns.description: British National Grid easting in metres for the area's reference location.

columns.name: y
columns.description: British National Grid northing in metres for the area's reference location.

columns.name: objectid
columns.description: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
